root_cause: A durable BusinessInput provider acknowledgement was required for demo-mode skips; a stale v3 test also rejected the current One Brain v4 impact version. Consequently unrelated portal UI PRs failed the shared suite despite correct candidate code.
prevention: In demo or preview state, explicit DEMO_NON_DURABLE skips clear pending local projection but never masquerade as stored durable records.
Authenticated writes continue to require authorization and stored:true provider receipt; no auth bypass.
Assert the current One Brain v4 cross-domain propagation contract in legacy causal regressions.

evidence.outcome: Repair shared portal regressions without lowering live customer write durability controls
